personalizedFeedback.title: ADDRESSING SKIN LAXITY
personalizedFeedback.description:
You have a very strong *bone foundation*, but visible *nasolabial folds* and mild sagging in the lower cheeks are the primary detractors from your score. This is a natural result of aging and loss of collagen.
To fix this, *skin tightening* treatments or *dermal fillers* in the mid-face/cheek area could lift the tissue and soften the folds, significantly improving your harmony.

personalizedFeedback.title: INFRAORBITAL REFINEMENT
personalizedFeedback.description:
There is mild *puffiness* and a lack of extreme compactness in the under-eye area. This creates a slightly "tired" look that contrasts with your otherwise strong bone structure.
A *lower blepharoplasty* to remove fat pads or the use of *tear trough fillers* would create a smoother transition from the eye to the cheek, increasing the "elite" feel of the eye area.

personalizedFeedback.title: LOWER THIRD BALANCE
personalizedFeedback.description:
Your *lower third* is slightly longer than the upper and middle thirds. While not a major flaw, it prevents the face from achieving perfect vertical symmetry.
While bone length cannot be changed without invasive surgery, *grooming the beard* to create a more squared-off, shorter appearance of the chin can visually compress the lower third.

personalizedFeedback.title: LIP VOLUME OPTIMIZATION
personalizedFeedback.description:
The lips are functional and balanced but lack the *fullness* associated with high-tier aesthetic markers.
A very subtle *lip augmentation* (filler) to the upper lip would balance the mouth width and improve the overall "pretty" appeal of the lower face.

personalizedFeedback.title: FACIAL DEFINITION
personalizedFeedback.description:
You have a good amount of *facial fat* that softens your jawline and cheekbones. While this contributes to a friendly appearance, it hides the underlying bone structure.
A slight *reduction in body fat percentage* would sharpen the jawline and make the cheekbones more prominent, potentially pushing your natural rating into the high 60s.
